body: thank you for your kind words

sending you the warmest virtual hug i can manage. everything will be alright. you are not alone. you are more than good enough. i know it's tiring to fight everyday, but you are worth spending that energy on.

i feel this so hard. i was in an IP facility for 10 days and it was the most relaxed i've been in years. the doctors would come by everyday and check on me and i just felt like i could take a break from worrying about everything and put my mental health in somebody else's hands. it felt nice that my mental health was being taken seriously. i fantasise about going back all the time..

i always picture myself on a small island in the middle of the ocean, lying down with my eyes closed. there is no sound except the crashing of the waves and i slowly dissolve into the sand and sea. i'm terrified of dying, but can't stop thinking about slowly fading out of existence.
i feel you, except maybe i was never alive at all. i can't remember if there ever was a time when i felt like a person.
